subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The __amateur__ proved them all wrong.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Professional**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"amateur"** means a person who engages in a pursuit, especially a sport, on an unpaid basis. (शौकिया)
 
 
• **Example: **He is an amateur photographer who takes pictures as a hobby, not as a job.
 
 
 
• **"Professional" **refers to a person engaged or qualified in a profession. (पेशेवर)
 
 
• **Example: **She is a professional musician who performs in concerts and records music for a living.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'amateur' **is **'professional'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Professional**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Prefect **(प्रधान छात्र): A senior student authorized to enforce discipline.
 
 
• **Example:** He was chosen as the school prefect for his leadership qualities.
 
 
 
• **Assistant **(सहायक): A person who helps in particular work.
 
 
• **Example: **She works as an assistant to the manager, helping with daily tasks.
 
 
 
• **Chef** (रसोइया): A professional cook, typically the chief cook in a restaurant or hotel.
 
 
• **Example:** The chef prepared a gourmet meal for the guests.
